## Hinge question · From terms to a sum {#ss4-hinge .ar-lesson .sequence-hinge .ar-hinge}

```{=html}
<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="2" class="hinge numeric-choices">
<p class="hinge-question">An arithmetic sequence has <span data-math="a_1=2">a₁ = 2</span> and <span data-math="a_2=5">a₂ = 5</span>. Evaluate <span class="ar-hinge-sum" data-math="\displaystyle\sum\limits_{k=1}^{10}a_k">the sum of a k from k equals 1 to 10</span>.</p>
<div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div>
<div class="choices">
<button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span data-math="29">29</span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span data-math="155">155</span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span data-math="170">170</span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span data-math="245">245</span></button>
</div>
<div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly.<br>On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div>
<div class="hinge-explanation" hidden><strong>2.</strong> <span data-math="d=5-2=3">d = 5 − 2 = 3</span><br><span data-math="\displaystyle\sum\limits_{k=1}^{10}a_k=\frac{10}{2}[2(2)+9(3)]=155">sum = 155</span></div>
</div>
```

::: notes

Default 60 seconds. Students keep a fist on their chest while thinking, then show 1–4 fingers together on the teacher’s verbal cue. The answer is revealed separately; timer expiry does not reveal it. 1: 29 is a_10 rather than the sum. 2: 155 is correct, using d=5−2=3 and nine increments. 3: 170 uses ten increments, replacing n−1 by n in the sum formula. 4: 245 incorrectly uses a_2=5 as the common difference. Ready: ask for the endpoint method, a_10=29 and 10(2+29)/2. Divided: ask what the summation symbol asks us to find, then identify a, d and n. Reteach: write 2,5,8,…,29 and distinguish the tenth term from the sum of all ten terms.

:::
